page_title: FRE 3-3 LEV | Freiburg v Bayer Leverkusen 07/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the right post.
90+4' Freiburg have a corner.
90+3' Although Christian Gunter (Freiburg) is just on the bench, Benjamin Brand has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+2' The main referee, Benjamin Brand, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) is given a yellow card for dissent.

90+1' What an opportunity! Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post!
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
89' Freiburg win a corner.
89' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Freiburg manage to earn a corner.
86' 3 - 3 It's a goal! Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 3:3.
82' Kasper Hjulmand has decided to substitute Ezequiel Fernandez and he is replaced by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' Substitution. Ernest Poku is replaced by Tim Oermann (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' Jarell Quansah (Bayer Leverkusen) is booked for saying more than Benjamin Brand was willing to tolerate.
80' Corner kicks – 4:2.
78' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.
78' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul.
77' The attendance for today's match is 34100.
77' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
75' Here is a change. Jan-Niklas Beste is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Cyriaque Irie (Freiburg).
75' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Johan Manzambi will be replaced by Lucas Holer (Freiburg).
75' The substitution is prepared. Montrell Culbreath (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Martin Terrier.
74' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

72' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom right corner, but Janis Blaswich pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
72' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) gets in a good position to shoot just outside the box after a nice pass, but his effort is unintentionally blocked by one of his teammate.

71' Ernest Poku (Bayer Leverkusen) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Noah Atubolu to get hold of the ball.
70' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
66' Substitution. Malik Tillman (Bayer Leverkusen) on for Ibrahim Maza.
66' That's a well-taken pass by Johan Manzambi (Freiburg). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
64' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Derry Scherhant (Freiburg).
62' The opposition back off Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
62' Vincenzo Grifo will be replaced by Derry Scherhant (Freiburg).
62' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Christian Gunter is replaced by Jordy Makengo (Freiburg).
62' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
61' The percentage of ball possession is – 38:62.
59' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes.
55' Ibrahim Maza (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to nod in a rebound. His close-range effort is denied by the goalkeeper, who pulls off a stunning save.
52' 2 - 3 Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. What a clinical finish!
51' Yellow card. Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
50' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
49' Freiburg are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+3' 2 - 2 Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) struck with a perfectly taken free kick from the edge of the box. He curled the ball straight inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives that can be used to describe that goal.
45+3' A free kick on the edge of the box for Bayer Leverkusen. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
45+1' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

45+1' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Janis Blaswich, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball goes behind for a corner. Freiburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' 2 - 1 Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
41' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle. Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) commits a foul after dangerous play.
41' A pass by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
39' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 9:9.
37' 1 - 1 Goal! Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
36' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
34' 1 - 0 Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) latches on to a killer pass deep inside the box and coolly puts the ball inside the right post!
33' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
31' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Benjamin Brand interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
29' Freiburg fail to score from a corner as Janis Blaswich (Bayer Leverkusen) leaps to collect the ball.
28' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
28' Bayer Leverkusen earn a corner.
27' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
26' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Freiburg are awarded a free kick.
23' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and it's Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
22' Ezequiel Fernandez (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
21' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
21' The ball possession is 40:60.
19' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes it short.

18' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) after he collected a pass and unleashed his low drive. The ball was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
17' Freiburg will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.

15' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Janis Blaswich guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
14' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
13' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
12' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
11' The Bayer Leverkusen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
7' Golden opportunity! Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
4' Benjamin Brand has a clear sight and sees a foul from Matthias Ginter (Freiburg).

3' Christian Kofane (Bayer Leverkusen) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar!
3' Neat passing move from Bayer Leverkusen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Freiburg will have the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
